##### Project general facts

South Lofts is an elevated co-living residence by PCI, designed for founders, creatives and professionals who want living, working and unwinding to meet naturally under one roof. The building offers studio and one-bedroom apartments, with private homes complemented by an extensive network of shared spaces on the podium and the roof. The concept is built around a sense of flow, moving residents easily between focus, connection and rest throughout the day, while keeping each personal space calm and private.

Amenities are organised around connection, renewal and restoration. The roof features an infinity-edge pool with a poolside bar, a dedicated fitness space for strength training, a social hub for work and play, and a restorative wellness area with a cold plunge. The podium level adds a communal dining space, a creative atelier, landscaped greens with a dedicated pet area, sports and play zones and a resident lounge. A light-filled lobby welcomes residents and guests on arrival.

Interiors are warm, modern and intentional, combining natural materials, clean lines and generous daylight across living areas, kitchens and bathrooms. Every apartment includes an integrated smart home system with a voice assistant, centralised lighting control, real-time energy monitoring and touch-control smart panels with customisable scenes. A digital smart lock supports multiple access modes, including remote app-based entry. Apartments are delivered with fitted kitchens and finished bathrooms, ready for residents to add their own furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Industrial City lies in the south of Dubai, close to Dubai South, Al Maktoum International Airport and the Jebel Ali logistics corridor. The district combines a major industrial and business base with residential neighbourhoods built for the people who work across this fast-growing part of the city. Expo City Dubai and Dubai Parks and Resorts sit a short drive away, adding leisure and events to the everyday business character of the area.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect the community with Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Jumeirah Village Circle and Dubai Hills. Ibn Battuta Mall and Dubai Hills Mall are within easy reach for shopping and dining, while Palm Jebel Ali and the coast lie to the west. Everyday retail, healthcare and services are available within the wider district, making daily routines simple for residents.

The area appeals to professionals working in logistics, aviation, trade and industry who want to live close to their workplace without giving up a modern lifestyle. Demand for compact, well-serviced homes is supported by the steady growth of employment around the airport and Dubai South. Affordable housing compared with more central communities makes the district attractive for investors focused on rental income from working professionals.
